Title: Platform: org, branch and chair hierarchy
Description: Org to branch to chair. Every record branch-scoped, rolling up to the org. A solo practice has exactly one branch. PLAT-01.

Title: Platform: roles and permissions
Description: Owner, Branch Manager, Front Desk, Doctor, Associate, Assistant, Accountant, Auditor. Grantable per branch so a user can be Doctor at A and Owner across all. PLAT-02.

Title: Platform: field-level permissions on financial data
Description: An associate sees their own production and payout, never the branch P&L or another doctor's numbers. PLAT-03.

Title: Platform: append-only audit log
Description: Actor, timestamp, branch, entity, before/after for every financial and clinical write. Queryable in-app by Owner and Auditor. PLAT-04.

Title: Platform: auth behind our own interface
Description: Supabase auth referenced only through src/lib/auth so the provider stays swappable. ADR-003.

Title: Platform: gapless numbering per branch per FY
Description: Invoices, receipts, credit notes. A table not a sequence, because sequences leak numbers on rollback and a gap is an auditor's question. PLAT-10.

Title: Platform: import tooling with dry-run and rollback
Description: CSV/Excel and incumbent exports, mapping UI, duplicate detection, rollback of a completed import. First-class module, not a services task. PLAT-07.

Title: Platform: free full data export
Description: Patients, treatments, ledgers, attachments. Advertised openly in the sales conversation. PLAT-08.

Title: Patients: org-level master with branch registrations
Description: One human, one record, however many branches. Registered at one, found instantly at another. PAT-01.

Title: Patients: 40-second registration
Description: Mobile as primary handle. Mandatory fields limited to name, mobile, sex, age or DOB. Speed is an acceptance criterion. PAT-02.

Title: Patients: duplicate detection and guided merge
Description: Fuzzy match on mobile, name and DOB at registration. Merge carries ledger, clinical and appointment history. PAT-03.

Title: Patients: household grouping
Description: One payer settles for dependants; one mobile serves several patients. PAT-04.

Title: Patients: referral source capture
Description: Configurable taxonomy at registration. Feeds attribution later. PAT-06.

Title: Scheduling: calendar against doctor and chair
Description: Multi-resource booking, 15-minute default granularity, per-procedure durations from the catalogue. SCH-01.

Title: Scheduling: day, week and chair-column views
Description: Drag to reschedule, colour by status. SCH-02.

Title: Scheduling: visiting specialist availability
Description: A doctor at branch A on Tuesdays and branch B on Thursdays. Cross-branch double-booking structurally impossible. SCH-03.

Title: Billing: service catalogue
Description: Code, name, duration, price, tax treatment, payout rule reference. Adding a specialty is a data import, not a release. BIL-01.

Title: Billing: invoice from performed procedures
Description: Line-level discount with reason code and approval threshold above which a manager must authorise. BIL-02.

Title: Billing: line-level GST classification
Description: DONE in domain layer. Exempt SAC 9993 vs taxable HSN 9021, HSN 3306 and cosmetic. Each line prints its own code, base, rate, amount. BIL-03.

Title: Billing: registered and unregistered branch profiles
Description: DONE in domain layer. An unregistered branch charges nothing whatever the catalogue says. BIL-04.

Title: Billing: receipts across all payment modes
Description: Cash, UPI with VPA, card per terminal, bank transfer, cheque, financing. Part payment across one or many invoices. BIL-05.

Title: Billing: patient ledger with running balance
Description: DONE in domain layer. Across all branches, shareable as a document. Derived from entries, never cached. BIL-06.

Title: Billing: advances as unearned revenue
Description: DONE in domain layer. Held and drawn down as procedures are delivered. Essential for implant and ortho cases. BIL-07.

Title: Billing: instalment schedules and collections worklist
Description: Due dates, overdue flagging, worklist sorted by ageing bucket. BIL-08.

Title: Billing: credit notes, refunds and write-offs
Description: Each requires a reason code and role-gated approval. Permanently visible in the audit log and ledger. BIL-09.

Title: Billing: unbilled procedure exception report
Description: Completed procedures with no invoice line after 24 hours, surfaced daily to the branch manager. The core leakage control. BIL-10.

Title: Billing: invoice PDF template
Description: Logo, registration numbers, doctor name and registration, branch address, terms, payment QR. BIL-12.

Title: Books: day-book close
Description: PARTIAL - reconciliation logic done, UI outstanding. Expected vs counted cash, denominations, mandatory variance explanation, lock, audited reopen. FIN-01.

Title: Books: doctor payout engine
Description: Percentage of collection or billing, flat per session or day, per procedure, minimum guarantee. Net of lab, consumables, discount. Versioned by effective date; a run is an immutable snapshot. FIN-03.

Title: Books: self-serve payout statements
Description: Every procedure, patient, date, collected amount, deductions, resulting share. The feature that ends payout disputes. FIN-04.

Title: Books: expense capture by cost centre
Description: Rent, salaries, lab, consumables, utilities, marketing. Vendor master, bill image, approval above threshold. FIN-06.

Title: Books: branch P&L
Description: Revenue, direct costs, operating costs, contribution, per branch per month, with drill-through. FIN-07.

Title: Books: profitability by doctor, procedure and chair-hour
Description: Which chair earns least per hour. A differentiating report no incumbent produces well. FIN-08.

Title: Books: GST working papers
Description: DONE in domain layer for the summary. Outward supply register split exempt/taxable, HSN/SAC summary, ITC apportionment. FIN-09.

Title: Books: Tally-compatible export
Description: XML against a mapped chart of accounts so the CA imports rather than re-keys. FIN-10.

Title: Analytics: owner dashboard
Description: Collections, billings, new vs returning, chair utilisation, receivables ageing, contribution. All branches side by side. ANA-01.

Title: Analytics: branch manager dashboard
Description: Today's schedule, arrivals, unbilled exceptions, cash position, collections worklist. ANA-02.

Title: Analytics: drill-through on every figure
Description: Numbers a user cannot audit are numbers they will not trust. ANA-06.

Title: Compliance: confirm GST treatment with a CA
Description: BLOCKING any customer-facing claim. The implant and cosmetic boundaries and the ITC apportionment approach. BRD Q5. Highest-damage error available to us.

Title: Compliance: reserve coded diagnosis capture for ABDM
Description: Column exists in schema and is unused in Phase 0. Retrofitting codes across a live patient database is the most commonly reported ABDM failure.
